entries.title: Homepage — where "Ask AI about me" lives
entries.context: The ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini logos sit in a row under the hero title and feel a little off there, maybe because they trail below the name. This round tries four different homes for them: the nav, beside your current status, above the name, and the floating Human / Agent pill. Hover the logos in each to feel the interaction. In every option the hero is otherwise unchanged.

options.name: Nav utility cluster
options.description: The logos join LinkedIn and X at the end of the nav, after a hairline divider. They sit with your other "outbound" links, show up on every page, and the hero is left to the name alone.

options.name: A line after your status
options.description: A sentence after "Currently… Previously…": "Short on time? Ask ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to sum me up." The logos ride inside text links, so it reads as an offer rather than a row of badges.

options.name: Eyebrow above the name
options.description: Tests the "it's because it's below" theory: same row, moved above the title as a small eyebrow. The name stays the last word in the hero, and the icons read as an intro rather than a trailing afterthought.

options.name: Docked with Human / Agent
options.description: The logos move out of the page into the floating Human / Agent pill: "Human | Agent · Ask AI ◎ ✳ ✦". Every AI-facing feature lives in one persistent control, visible on every page while scrolling.

entries.chosenNote: First shipped C (icons above the name, no label), then switched the same day to B, revised: a third status line "Ask anything" + logos only (no AI names), set in the same .text-size-large type as the status, logos sized in em, same muted/scale-1.2/tooltip hover. Shipped in index.html (#overview) and css/dark-mode.css.
